{{Top|leg}}
The '''Historical District''' was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Estalle]] on [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia's]] [[Estalle Island]]. The seat of the [[Tapani Federation]]'s government was located in the Historial District, including various embassies, plazas, and parks. Buildings in the Historical District could not be more than five stories tall due to zoning regulations. During the day, the district was open to everyone, but after working hours only the [[Noble/Legends|nobility]] and commoners with access permits were allowed to enter.<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>

Structures within the Historial District included [[Shey Tapani]]'s [[The Palace|Palace]], [[Shey Tapani University/Legends|Shey Tapani University]], [[Ganza Park]], [[Leocald Opera House]], the [[Great Council Chambers]], the [[Senate Building (Procopia)|Senate Building]], [[Gorgano IV Museum]], [[Tapeno Library]], the [[Imperial Embassy (Procopia)|Imperial Embassy]], [[Barnaba Embassy]], [[Cadriaan Embassy]], [[Calipsa Embassy]], [[Reena Embassy]], [[Mecetti Embassy]], [[Melantha Embassy]], and [[Pelagia Embassy]].<ref name="LE" />
